jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python/Cloud)
jobs.description: Seeking an experienced Senior Backend Engineer to architect scalable cloud microservices. Must have deep expertise in Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL database design, containerization with Docker, and cloud deployments on AWS. 4+ years required.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Looking for a Machine Learning Platform Engineer to build scalable model serving pipelines. Strong proficiency in Python, PyTorch or TensorFlow, Docker containers, and SQL databases required. 3+ years required.
